name: OpenMP build + 20-core run
command:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@spark 'cd ~/bonsai2/asm && python3 - <<PYEOF
s = open("tq_gemv_neon.c").read()
o = "    int ng = cols / 128;\n    int8_t tmp[32];\n    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {"
assert s.count(o) == 1
n = "    int ng = cols / 128;\n    int8_t tmp[32];\n    (void)tmp;\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {"
open("tq_gemv_neon.c","w").write(s.replace(o, n, 1))
print("omp pragma added")
PYEOF
LB=~/bonsai2/llama.cpp/build/bin && gcc -O2 -fopenmp -march=armv8.2-a+dotprod -DTQ_XGEMV_LIB -Dmain=tq_neon_main -c tq_gemv_neon.c -o fwd_neon_mt.o 2>&1 | head -5 && gcc -O2 -fopenmp -o fwd_mt fwd.o fwd_neon_mt.o fwht.S -L$LB -lggml-base -lggml-cpu -Wl,-rpath,$LB -lm 2>&1 | head -5 && echo BUILD_OK && OMP_NUM_THREADS=20 time taskset -c 0-19 ./fwd_mt ../models/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-PTQ1_0.gguf 826 279 2943 15127 321 799 3065 421 4203 303 1754 13 --gen 5 2>/dev/null | grep "^step"' 2>&1 | head -25
